## INCIDENT REPORT: Network Forensic Analysis

**Analysis Date:** 2024-07-30  
**Analyst:** Network Forensics Team

---

### INFECTED HOST IDENTIFICATION

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| **IPv4 Address** | 172.16.1.66 |
| **MAC Address** | 00:1e:64:ec:f3:08 |
| **Windows Hostname** | DESKTOP-SKBR25F |
| **Logged-In User** | ccollier |
| **Operating System** | Windows 11 Pro, 64-bit |

---

### MALWARE IDENTIFICATION

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| **Malware Family** | STRRAT (Remote Access Trojan) |
| **Version** | 1.6 |
| **Attribution** | Signature-confirmed via C&C beacon payload |
| **Beacon Interval** | Approximately 5 seconds |

**Beacon Evidence:** The malware transmits telemetry to C&C with plaintext field delimiters:  
`ping|STRRAT|1BE8292C|DESKTOP-SKBR25F|ccollier|Microsoft Windows 11 Pro|64-bit|Windows Defender||1.6|US:United States|Not Installed|[interval]`

---

### INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE (IOCs)

#### Command-and-Control (C2) Endpoints
- **IP:Port** - `141.98.10.79:12132` (Protocol: Custom TCP)
- **Connection Pattern** - Persistent bidirectional communication with 5-second beacon intervals
- **Total Traffic** - 411 frames, 39 kB upstream / 27 kB downstream over 508 seconds

#### Malicious Domains
- None detected in DNS queries (C&C uses direct IP address)

#### Malicious URLs
- None detected in HTTP traffic

#### Downloaded Files and Hashes

| File Name | Type | SHA256 Hash |
|-----------|------|------------|
| pas.ps1 | PowerShell Script | `a833f27c2bb4cad31344e70386c44b5c221f031d7cd2f2a6b8601919e790161e` |
| [Unnamed Large Payload] | Binary | `798563fcf7600f7ef1a35996291a9dfb5f9902733404dd499e2e736ea1dc6fc5` |

**PowerShell Script Details:** Obfuscated Base64-encoded PowerShell command using string replacement and encoding evasion. The script was extracted from HTTP objects exported from the PCAP.

---

### SECONDARY OBSERVATIONS

- **Domain Access:** The infected host accessed administrative shares on the domain controller (WIRESHARK-WS-DC):
  - `\\WIRESHARK-WS-DC\Shared_Access` (multiple connections)
  - `\\WIRESHARK-WS-DC\sysvol` (Group Policy object access)
  - `\\WIRESHARK-WS-DC\IPC$` (inter-process communication)

- **Network Reconnaissance:** The host queried external geolocation service (ip-api.com) and Microsoft telemetry services, consistent with post-compromise activity.

- **No Data Exfiltration Detected:** No large-scale outbound data transfer beyond the beaconing traffic itself.

---

### CONCLUSION

Host 172.16.1.66 (DESKTOP-SKBR25F) is infected with STRRAT v1.6 running under user context `ccollier`. The malware actively beacons to C&C server 141.98.10.79:12132 every 5 seconds and has downloaded obfuscated PowerShell and binary payloads. Evidence of lateral movement reconnaissance to the domain controller is present.
